subject: [PATCH] sched_ext: Test scx_has_subs() inline before calling sub-sched hooks

reviews.author: Tejun Heo
reviews.summary: Identified the need for a more efficient approach and suggested moving the sub-scheduler test into inline wrappers to reduce unnecessary function calls and register saves.

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch moves the test for sub-schedulers into inline wrappers to avoid unnecessary function calls and register saves on every context switch, dispatch, or local DSQ insert.
